narrative.overview: SmartRide embraces an airy, high-contrast daylight aesthetic anchored by Forest Emerald (#047857) and Sunrise Amber (#C2410C), conveying unshakeable trust, verifiable safety, and everyday commuter convenience.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Daylight Canvas (#F6F8F7) eliminating glare while maintaining deep contrast.
Dual-Accent Hierarchy: Forest Emerald for trust and safety, Sunrise Amber for transit urgency.
True 3-Tier Elevation (Canvas -> White Card -> Recessed Slate Panel).
Legible Human Typography using Plus Jakarta Sans and Inter.

rules.name: The Dual Anchor Rule
rules.body: Emerald guides the user forward into confirmed trust; Amber draws attention to temporal urgency and live changes. Never use Amber for non-urgent decorative accents.

rules.name: The No-Mud Rule
rules.body: Never place washed-out gray text on colored backgrounds. On colored pill badges, text must be a high-contrast deep shade of that hue or crisp white.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, badges, and headers must use Sentence case or Title Case. Never use ALL CAPS with heavy tracking for standard form labels or badge titles.

rules.name: The 3-Tier Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Level 0 is canvas (#F6F8F7), Level 1 is white card (#FFFFFF), Level 2 is recessed panel (#F8FAFC). Never nest a pure white card inside another pure white card.

dos: Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio for all secondary and metadata copy.
Do use Sentence case for badges, button copy, and field labels.
Do use the 3-tier elevation model for complex information grouping.
Do preserve the dual-accent role: Emerald for trust, Amber for transit urgency.
donts: Don't use ALL CAPS for labels, table headers, or badges.
Don't use pure gray text on colored badge backgrounds.
Don't use decorative gradient text on metrics or headings.
Don't use heavy dark borders (border-l-4) or generic harsh drop shadows.
